name: Chapman
source:
An informant who used to stay in Thailand.
Because of his connection with the Web, Yeung Kwun bribed him to help Lycoris escape.
At the request of Ramrowan, he contacted Lycoris in search of an assassin to purge No.7.
After the military revolution in Thailand, he fled to Hong Kong and reunited with Yvet while working as a subcontractor for the CIA.
He provides information on the Raksasa Party and the Lao Pao's Fortress Mansion.
